CustomField.description: Why a delivery reached Ignored, as a value rather than as prose. Ignored conflates two different outcomes: Superseded means a newer delivery for the same external id won inside the batch, and the winner carries the whole story. Not Applicable means the adapter had nothing to say about the resource - an Asana story event, for instance - so no retry would ever produce a change. Retention rules read this field; before it existed the only way to tell them apart was to string-match Error_Message__c, which breaks silently the day somebody rewords a message. Null on every row that is not Ignored.
CustomField.label: Ignore Reason
